designPhilosophy: Survival tools act as tactical valves and positional setups rather than 'skip-level' buttons. Every tool carries a per-mission cap, cooldown, or board trade-off so puzzle mastery remains primary.

tools.name: Artisan Mallet (Hammer)
tools.purpose: Shatters 1 HP layer of a single targeted board obstacle or pops 1 unlocked candy without spending a turn.
tools.howItWorks: Player taps the Hammer slot, then taps any valid board tile. Deals 1 structural hit to Bamboo Cages, Ice, Chains, Coconut Husks, or Crates, or triggers 1 candy/special.
tools.whenCanBeUsed: During player idle input phase on the puzzle board (disabled mid-cascade).
tools.limitations: Cannot destroy indestructible mission Keys, Brass Trunks (requires key-gems), or multi-HP armored obstacles in a single hit; max 2 uses per mission.
tools.visualEffect: A carved rosewood-and-sugar mallet swings down in 3D with radial candy dust and a crisp contact shockwave.
tools.candyInteraction: If used directly on a Striped, Wrapped, or Jilapi Coil candy, immediately detonates that special candy in place.
tools.difficultyImpact: Relieves single-tile choke bottlenecks (such as a final block under a Key) without clearing entire objective quotas.

tools.name: Cryo Freeze Blast
tools.purpose: Temporarily halts advancing enemies in the upper survival arena for 6 seconds (or 2 enemy turn ticks).
tools.howItWorks: Broadcasts a cold shockwave across the rescue stage, encasing active enemies in translucent frost rime and pushing danger back by 8%.
tools.whenCanBeUsed: Anytime during active gameplay while danger is below 99%.
tools.limitations: Does not halt non-biological mechanical crushers (`OBS_PISTON_CANDY_CRUSHER`) and has a 15-second cooldown between charges; Lava Crawlers thaw 40% faster.
tools.visualEffect: Expanding sapphire frost ring with floating ice prisms and crystalline rim-shader override on monsters.
tools.candyInteraction: Also freezes spreading Chili-Ember Fire on the board for 1 turn so it cannot propagate.
tools.difficultyImpact: Buys a critical 2-move window to complete a 4/5-candy setup under high survival pressure.

tools.name: Bazaar Basket Shuffle
tools.purpose: Rearranges all movable normal candies when the board has poor synergy, guaranteeing at least two 4-match opportunities.
tools.howItWorks: Lifts all unchained, non-key candies into a swirling woven bamboo basket vortex and redistributes them into high-potential clusters.
tools.whenCanBeUsed: During idle board state when at least 6 movable candies exist.
tools.limitations: Does not move locked, iced, slimed, or caged tiles; costs 1 tool charge (auto-deadlock shuffles remain free but do not bias toward 4-matches).
tools.visualEffect: Candies arc upward in a spiral ribbon trail with golden chimes before snapping cleanly back into tile wells.
tools.candyInteraction: Preserves existing Special Candies on the board and upgrades 1 random fruit candy into a Striped candy.
tools.difficultyImpact: Mitigates RNG drought on compartmentalized boards while still requiring the player to spot and execute the resulting combos.

tools.name: Crystal Sugar Shield
tools.purpose: Wraps Mochi in a shimmering spun-sugar dome that blocks exactly one incoming hazard hit, slime spit, or enemy lunge.
tools.howItWorks: Applies a 1-stack protective barrier around Mochi in the rescue arena. When danger hits 100% or a falling rock/projectile strikes Mochi, the dome shatters and knocks the threat back 22%.
tools.whenCanBeUsed: Proactively during active play before Mochi is caught.
tools.limitations: Strictly 1-charge per mission; does not protect against floor collapse if Mochi has no platform beneath her (`OBS_ROPE_SLAT_BRIDGE` total collapse).
tools.visualEffect: Iridescent geodesic sugar-glass bubble humming around Mochi that bursts into rainbow shards upon absorbing a hit.
tools.candyInteraction: Matching 5 candies (Rainbow Bomb) while Shield is active overcharges the dome to reflect 1 projectile back at Bosses.
tools.difficultyImpact: Provides a forgiving safety net on spike-damage levels without advancing collection objectives.

tools.name: Golden Jute Grapple Rope
tools.purpose: Creates a temporary braided jute zip-line or swing bypass across 1 missing bridge segment or flooded pit.
tools.howItWorks: Fires a bamboo grappling hook above Mochi, allowing her to cross 1 unbuilt bridge gap or hover safely above rising lava/water for 8 seconds.
tools.whenCanBeUsed: On bridge, chasm, flood, or multi-ledge survival missions.
tools.limitations: Bridges only 1 segment out of multi-segment chasms; rope frays after 8 seconds (or 3 moves) if the permanent objective isn't finished.
tools.visualEffect: Braided golden Bengal jute fiber line snaps taut between carved wooden posts as Mochi holds on with both hands.
tools.candyInteraction: Matching Guava or Jackfruit candies while Mochi hangs on the rope reinforces its duration by +2 seconds.
tools.difficultyImpact: Lets players survive a temporary lava/tide surge while hunting for the last bridge plank matches.

tools.name: Amber Gur Hourglass (Time Boost)
tools.purpose: Adds +12 seconds to real-time survival missions or +3 emergency moves on turn-capped missions.
tools.howItWorks: Flips an ornate brass-and-jaggery sandglass, slowing arena hazard clocks by 50% for 4 seconds while adding buffer time/moves.
tools.whenCanBeUsed: Once per mission when remaining time < 20s or remaining moves <= 5.
tools.limitations: Cannot be stacked repeatedly in the same level (hard cap: 1 per attempt); does not unlock jammed mechanical gates.
tools.visualEffect: Warm golden time-dust ripples across the HUD clock and briefly tints the arena in slow-motion amber light.
tools.candyInteraction: During the 4-second slow-motion window, cascading matches grant +25% bonus score.
tools.difficultyImpact: Converts razor-thin 95%-complete losses into clutch victories while still requiring the player to clear the remaining tasks.

tools.name: Jilapi Spark Bomb (Candy Bomb)
tools.purpose: Places and detonates a high-energy 3x3 blast on a chosen board coordinate to crack dense obstacle clusters.
tools.howItWorks: Player drags the Jilapi Spark Bomb onto any board cell; it pulses once and blasts a 3x3 square, dealing 1 damage to all obstacles in range.
tools.whenCanBeUsed: During idle board input; 2-move cooldown if multiple charges are carried.
tools.limitations: In Cave/Foothill levels (`OBS_LOOSE_SHALE_ROCKFALL`), heavy bomb blasts shake loose 2 small pebble blockers at the top of the board—demanding smart timing!
tools.visualEffect: Sizzling golden spiral firework expands into a crisp 3D shockwave ring with caramelized sparks.
tools.candyInteraction: Triggers chain reactions with any Striped, Wrapped, or Prism Mirror tiles inside its 3x3 blast zone.
tools.difficultyImpact: Breaks symmetric blocker walls in mid/late chapters while carrying tactical seismic risk in rockfall caves.

tools.name: Royal Kulfi Ice Cannon
tools.purpose: Fires a concentrated cryo-beam that simultaneously freezes 1 arena hazard lane AND solidifies molten lava/bog tiles in a selected column.
tools.howItWorks: Player selects a target column; the cannon fires upward from that column into the rescue arena, cooling lava/fire along the path and stunning any enemy above that column.
tools.whenCanBeUsed: During active play; requires aiming at one of the board columns.
tools.limitations: Narrow 1-column width—missing a fast-moving Flying Candy Thief wastes the stun portion; 18-second cooldown.
tools.visualEffect: Creamy mint-sapphire beam laced with pistachio crystal flecks leaves a frosted crust trail from board to arena.
tools.candyInteraction: Turns 1 random candy in the fired column into a `CANDY_PISTACHIO_KULFI` special piece.
tools.difficultyImpact: Rewards spatial alignment between board column selection and enemy position in the arena.

tools.name: Orchard Harvester Magnet
tools.purpose: Pulls stranded mission Keys, Brass Tokens, or Fruit Baskets 2 rows downward through normal candies (or collects up to 5 loose target fruits).
tools.howItWorks: Generates a downward magnetic pulse at the bottom exit chutes, swapping each Key downward past up to 2 normal unlocked candies.
tools.whenCanBeUsed: When at least 1 collectible drop item or fruit quota is active on the board.
tools.limitations: Blocked by solid obstacles (`OBS_BAMBOO_WOOD_CAGE`, `OBS_SLIDING_STONE_WALL`, `OBS_COCONUT_HUSK_BUMPER`)—players must clear hard blockers beneath the Key first!
tools.visualEffect: U-shaped brass-and-bamboo magnet hums with golden field rings below the board, tugging metallic keys downward.
tools.candyInteraction: After keys shift 2 rows down, displaced candies settle and can trigger natural cascade matches.
tools.difficultyImpact: Eliminates frustrating final-row stalls on Key levels without bypassing solid obstacle puzzles.

tools.name: Tender Coconut Extinguisher
tools.purpose: Extinguishes up to 4 Chili-Ember Fire Barriers on the board and cools rising Caramel Lava by 20%.
tools.howItWorks: Sprays a wide cone of chilled coconut-foam across burning board tiles and onto the arena lava surface.
tools.whenCanBeUsed: Active whenever Fire Barriers, Lava Crawlers, or Rising Caramel Lava are present.
tools.limitations: Ineffective against Ice, Water, Chains, or Mechanical enemies; extinguished lava re-heats after 10 seconds if objectives stall.
tools.visualEffect: Billowing white frothy coconut-milk spray with cool steam puffs and sizzling audio feedback.
tools.candyInteraction: Leaves clean wet droplets on 2 extinguished candies, granting +1 bonus count if matched on the next move.
tools.difficultyImpact: Prevents runaway fire-spread spirals when the board gets cramped.

tools.name: Monsoon Hydro Blaster
tools.purpose: High-pressure water jet that flushes Sticky Mango Slime, Honeycomb Wax, and Mud Bog across a 2-row horizontal sweep.
tools.howItWorks: Player taps any row; a brass pump-nozzle sweeps across that row and the row below, dissolving all 1-layer sticky coatings without destroying the candies underneath.
tools.whenCanBeUsed: During player input phase; max 2 charges per mission.
tools.limitations: Do NOT use carelessly in Monsoon Flood levels (`OBS_MONSOON_FLOOD_TIDE`), where firing adds +5% water height to the flood gauge—creating a genuine tactical trade-off!
tools.visualEffect: Sparkling turquoise pressurized water stream arcs left-to-right with rainbow mist droplets.
tools.candyInteraction: Frees slimed Special Candies intact so they can immediately be swapped on the same turn.
tools.difficultyImpact: Hard-counters Slime Monster & Boss slime barrages while demanding flood-gauge awareness in Chapter 7.

tools.name: Crystal Swap Teleporter
tools.purpose: Teleports and exchanges any two non-locked items anywhere on the board—even non-adjacent tiles!
tools.howItWorks: Player taps Tile A and Tile B anywhere on the grid. Both pieces warp through twin violet-gold portals without consuming a move.
tools.whenCanBeUsed: During idle input; works on normal candies, Special Candies, and unlocked Golden Keys.
tools.limitations: Cannot target Chained, Iced, Caged, or Solid Wall cells; does not auto-detonate unless the teleported placement forms a 3+ match.
tools.visualEffect: Twin spinning geometric quartz portals open beneath both tiles as the pieces beam across in a flash of prism light.
tools.candyInteraction: Enables pro-level plays: teleporting a Rainbow Bomb next to a Striped Candy across the board, or warping a Key from a blocked column to an open drain chute!
tools.difficultyImpact: Highest skill-ceiling tool in the game—rewards clever board reading rather than brute force.

tools.name: Sylhet Bamboo Gust Fan
tools.purpose: Dispels all Tea Mist clouds on the board, reverses Wind Tunnel currents for 2 turns, and blows Flying Candy Thieves away.
tools.howItWorks: Swings a giant woven palm-and-bamboo fan, sweeping clean air diagonally across both puzzle board and rescue canopy.
tools.whenCanBeUsed: Whenever Mist, Wind Tunnels, Airborne Spores, or Flying Thieves are active.
tools.limitations: Fans Chili-Ember Fire if active (causing 1 spark hop if fire isn't extinguished first!), reinforcing elemental mindfulness.
tools.visualEffect: Swirling emerald tea leaves and golden wind ribbons sweep across the 3D viewport.
tools.candyInteraction: Shifts loose airborne bubble-candies 1 column toward the center where combos are easier to form.
tools.difficultyImpact: Restores full board visibility in fog chapters and interrupts aerial theft animations.

tools.name: Golden Resin Platform Clamp
tools.purpose: Stabilizes Crumbling Biscuit Platforms, Collapsing Bridges, and Rotating Gates in their current state for 3 moves (or 10 seconds).
tools.howItWorks: Coats structural joints in amber jackfruit-tree resin, locking moving/falling arena mechanisms in place.
tools.whenCanBeUsed: Strategic timing tool—must be triggered WHILE a Rotating Gate is open or BEFORE a platform drops!
tools.limitations: If triggered while a Rotating Gate is in the CLOSED orientation, it locks the gate closed too—timing matters!
tools.visualEffect: Warm glowing amber resin crystallizes around platform hinges and bridge ropes.
tools.candyInteraction: Also prevents Sliding Stone Walls on the board from shifting for 2 turns.
tools.difficultyImpact: Transforms frantic twitch-timing platform hazards into controlled puzzle windows.

tools.name: Giant Rasgulla Trampoline
tools.purpose: Deploys a super-elastic spongy Rasgulla cushion ahead of or beneath Mochi to deflect 1 rolling boulder or bounce her over a ground spike trap.
tools.howItWorks: Drops a plump white syrup-sponge pad onto Mochi's immediate track segment.
tools.whenCanBeUsed: On Boulder, Spike Trap, Falling Rock, or Multi-Tier Ledge levels.
tools.limitations: Absorbs 1 heavy boulder/rock impact before squishing flat; ineffective against liquid hazards (lava/flood).
tools.visualEffect: Comical squishy jelly deformation physics with sparkling sugar-syrup droplets and a boing harmonic.
tools.candyInteraction: Spawns 2 `CANDY_SPONGY_RASGULLA` pieces onto the top row of the puzzle board.
tools.difficultyImpact: Counters boulder/crusher checkpoints while feeding sponge candies back into the match grid.

tools.name: Firefly Glass Jar Beacon
tools.purpose: Illuminates darkened cave/canopy zones and dazzles nocturnal Jungle Crawlers or Mirage Chameleons, locking their color camouflage.
tools.howItWorks: Releases a warm swarm of bioluminescent orchard fireflies from a mason jar.
tools.whenCanBeUsed: In shadowed cavern levels or against camouflaged/stealth enemies.
tools.limitations: Lasts 3 moves (or 12 seconds); does not deal direct obstacle damage.
tools.visualEffect: Dozens of warm golden 3D point-light fireflies orbit Mochi and highlight optimal hint matches on the board.
tools.candyInteraction: Reveals hidden color identities of camouflaged/misted candies and forces Mirage Chameleon to stay vulnerable.
tools.difficultyImpact: Removes information-hiding friction in late-game chapters.

tools.name: Brass Riverboat Winch
tools.purpose: Manually cranks Timed Escape Doors, Sluice Floodgates, or Ferry Gondolas forward by +25% progress.
tools.howItWorks: Attaches a heavy brass river-barge pulley to the primary mechanical arena gate and winches it 1 stage open.
tools.whenCanBeUsed: Only on missions featuring mechanical gates, ferries, or timed shutters; max 1 use per mission.
tools.limitations: If a gate is still padlocked by a Key objective, the winch cannot pull until the Key lock is disengaged first.
tools.visualEffect: Spinning brass gears and taut steel cable crank the heavy door upward with metallic ratcheting audio.
tools.candyInteraction: Clears 1 Wrought Metal Chain on the board from excess cable tension.
tools.difficultyImpact: Provides clutch mechanical progress in complex multi-objective late-game stages.

tools.name: Saffron Glaze Color Brush
tools.purpose: Repaints up to 3 contiguous normal candies into a single fruit color of the player's choice to engineer 5-in-a-row Rainbow Bombs or L/T combos.
tools.howItWorks: Player selects the brush, drags across up to 3 adjacent unlocked candies, and releases; all 3 adopt the color of the first touched candy.
tools.whenCanBeUsed: During idle board state; 1 charge per mission.
tools.limitations: Only paints up to 3 tiles—to form a 4-match or 5-match Rainbow Bomb, the player must paint next to 1–2 existing matching candies and execute the final swap!
tools.visualEffect: Lush glossy saffron-gold pastry brush strokes glossy color glaze over each touched 3D candy.
tools.candyInteraction: Directly enables player-crafted Striped, Wrapped, Energy Bomb, or Rainbow Color Bomb formations on demand.
tools.difficultyImpact: Rewards foresight and geometry planning on Expert/Master levels (41–50).
